# Chip Mortgage Calculator

> A native iPhone and iPad mortgage calculator for US fixed-rate home loans. The current App Store version 1.0 is a one-time paid download. The planned 1.0.1 update will make core calculations and on-screen schedules free with an optional permanent saving/PDF/CSV purchase. It is not live yet. No ads or subscriptions.

- Monthly Payment counts principal and interest, property tax, home insurance, PMI (only below 20% down, ends at 78% of the original price), HOA dues, upkeep, utilities and extra principal.
- Tax and insurance start as US averages (0.9% and 0.5% of the price per year) and can be edited.
- Shows the payoff date, a monthly cost chart, loan facts, total repayment, and interest and time saved with extra payments.
- Monthly and annual cash flow tables with principal, interest, extra principal and balance; CSV export.
- A two or three page PDF report to share. Saved plans and shareable plan files.
- First launch uses the US median home price ($429,100, NAR, August 2026) with 20% down and the latest Freddie Mac 30-year average rate from the St. Louis Fed (FRED).
- Privacy: no data collected, no tracking, no analytics. Network use includes the public FRED rate fetch on first launch and, in 1.0.1, Apple purchase/restore services. Plans stay on the device.
- Estimates only, not financial advice.

- [Verified App Store listing](https://apps.apple.com/app/id6821645194)
